week.headline: The NFELO model's strongest pick is San Francisco over Las Vegas, at 79%.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 12.9 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Cleveland's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 31%. Jacksonville is the Super Bowl favorite at 12%.
